title: Money Was Never One Thing
listing_description: The original prologue recovers the strangeness of money and opens a history of plural monetary forms, institutions, and design choices.
reader_hook: Begin with the familiar object in your pocket and follow the argument that money is neither natural nor singular, but designed social infrastructure.

source_excerpt.start_heading: PROLOGUE — THE MONEY IN YOUR POCKET IS STRANGER THAN YOU THINK
source_excerpt.end_heading: PART I — FROM MONETARY PLURALITY TO MONETARY DESIGN
